card.title: Flashcard
card.description: A single vocabulary flashcard created by the user or auto-generated by AI.

translation.description: The Vietnamese translation of the word.

explanation.description: Simple English definition or usage context.

category.description: The categorization of vocabulary (e.g. Science, Tech).

imageUrl.description: URL of the Wikipedia visual representation image.

bookmarked.description: Whether this word has been starred/bookmarked.

userProfile.title: UserProfile
userProfile.description: The user's overall learning stats, active milestones, and streak records.

streak.description: Current consecutive days active learning streak.

lastActive.description: The date string of the user's last activity.

/users/{userId}/cards/{cardId}.description: Collections of cards created or saved by specific users.

/users/{userId}/profile/stats.description: A single statistics object recording user streak data and active history.
